gates.name: Authority Budget
gates.question: Can you name the exact external action this workflow is allowed to perform?
gates.rationale: If the consequential action is vague, the authority boundary cannot be tested.

gates.name: Object binding
gates.question: Can the workflow prove which exact object the action applies to before execution?
gates.rationale: Correct permission on the wrong record, account or document is still the wrong effect.

gates.name: Authority owner
gates.question: Is there a named role that owns the permission to perform this action?
gates.rationale: Authority without an owner becomes difficult to approve, constrain or revoke.

gates.name: Evidence Before Effect
gates.question: Is the minimum pre-action evidence explicitly defined?
gates.rationale: A workflow cannot fail closed on missing evidence if the evidence requirement is implicit.

gates.name: Freshness
gates.question: Does the workflow know when required evidence has become stale or invalid?
gates.rationale: A healthy-looking service can still be operating on truth that stopped advancing.

gates.name: External confirmation
gates.question: Is the intended external effect independently confirmed after the action?
gates.rationale: Internal completion or a tool acknowledgement is not proof that the outside system reached the expected state.

gates.name: Recovery
gates.question: When evidence or confirmation becomes uncertain, does the workflow enter a defined constrained/recovery state?
gates.rationale: Retrying or continuing through ambiguity can turn one uncertain action into repeated effects.
